property.name: Roubený ráj
property.tagline: Libošovice · the southern tip of Bohemian Paradise
property.headline: A place where there's no need to rush!
property.perex:
In the heart of Bohemian Paradise, in the little village of Libošovice, there's a place where time runs a little slower.
Roubený ráj is a cosy log cottage for family and friends who want a few days' break from the everyday rush, time together and the beauty of Bohemian Paradise.
property.about:
The cottage has kept the charm of a traditional timber house while offering all the comfort you'd expect from a holiday today.
You'll have the whole house to yourselves.
Three bedrooms sleep up to 10 guests in comfort, the cosy interior with its wood-burning stove is made for time together, and the fully equipped kitchen invites you to cook something delicious together.
Because in the end, it's the simple moments that turn out to be the best.
There are two bathrooms with a shower and WC, a washing machine, Wi-Fi and space to store bikes and scooters.
For outdoor seating, there's a period granary with a truly magical atmosphere.
And of course there's an outdoor fire pit, too.

reservationTerms.deposit: 50% deposit once your dates are confirmed
reservationTerms.cancellation: Free cancellation 61 or more days before arrival; after that, a fee of 25% of the price (31–60 days), 50% (15–30 days) or 100% (14 days or fewer)

beds.title: Nine beds plus an extra bed
beds.description: Three attic bedrooms — two with a double bed, one with five beds. Orthopaedic mattresses on slatted bases; the only thing aching in the morning will be your calves.

barn.title: Barn with table tennis and table football
barn.description: Bats, balls and rows of little footballers on their rods. It starts as a ‘quick’ tournament and ends in rematches until evening.

granary.title: A granary instead of a pergola
granary.description: A table under old timber beams, out of reach of rain and the midday sun. So the evening only ends when you want it to.

fire.title: Fire pit and barbecue in the yard
fire.description: A lawn, garden furniture and a fire that's perfect for comfortable silence. Don't forget the sausages!

kitchen.title: A kitchen for the whole gang
kitchen.description: Induction hob with oven, dishwasher, microwave, toaster, kettle and fridge. Cooking for ten is no problem.

bathrooms.title: Two bathrooms
bathrooms.description: One on the ground floor, the other in the attic — no morning queues. A washing machine goes without saying.

village.title: Shop and pub within walking distance
village.description: A grocery with a café a hundred metres away, a restaurant two hundred, the bus stop eighty. Your car can stay parked all week.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi, and otherwise peace and quiet
wifi.description: The connection works if you really need it. After the first evening, hardly anyone goes looking for it.

checkInOut.title: Self check-in/out
checkInOut.description:
Self check-in makes for a relaxed start to your stay.
No waiting for a key handover and no need to fit your arrival around anyone else. We'll send you everything you need before you set off, and when you arrive you simply let yourselves in.

babies.title: We think of the little ones too
babies.description:
To make the stay easy for the whole family, we've prepared a few little things that make life simpler for parents and turn the stay into a small adventure for the children.
A cosy cot, a step stool, a potty, a baby bath and, of course, toys are waiting for them.

loznice.title: Bedrooms
loznice.perex: Three attic bedrooms, nine fixed beds and an extra bed on request.
loznice.description:
Two bedrooms have a double bed and the third has five beds — nine beds in total, plus an extra bed by arrangement.
Every bed has an orthopaedic mattress on a slatted base; the only thing aching in the morning will be your calves after the day's outing.

manzelska1.title: Double bedroom
manzelska1.description: An attic room with a double bed.

manzelska2.title: Bedroom with a dormer window
manzelska2.description: The second room with a double bed, with a dormer window overlooking the garden.

petiluzkova.title: Five-bed bedroom
petiluzkova.description: The largest of the attic bedrooms — for the children, or for a group that wants to stay together.

kuchyne.title: Kitchen and living room
kuchyne.perex: A fully equipped kitchen opening onto the living room and dining table.
kuchyne.description:
Induction hob with oven, dishwasher, microwave, toaster, kettle and fridge — cooking for ten is no problem.
The kitchen opens onto the living room with its wood-burning stove and large dining table. It's where the whole house ends up gathering.

koupelny.title: Bathrooms and utilities
koupelny.perex: Two bathrooms with a shower and WC, plus a washing machine.
koupelny.description:
One bathroom is on the ground floor and the other in the attic, so there's no queue in the morning.
Both have a shower and WC; a washing machine goes without saying.

deti.title: For the little ones
deti.perex: Cot, step stool, potty, baby bath and toys.
deti.description:
To make the stay easy for the whole family, the cottage is ready for its youngest guests too.
A cosy cot, a step stool, a potty, a baby bath and, of course, toys are waiting for them.

stodola.title: Barn
stodola.perex: Table tennis and table football under cover.
stodola.description:
The barn has a table tennis table and table football, complete with bats, balls and rows of little footballers on their rods.
It starts as a ‘quick’ tournament and ends in rematches until evening — and the rain can't get you in there.

dvorek.title: Granary and yard
dvorek.perex: Covered seating in a period granary, plus a fire pit and barbecue in the yard.
dvorek.description:
The period granary offers a table under old timber beams, out of reach of rain and the midday sun — so the evening only ends when you want it to.
In the yard there's a lawn, garden furniture and a fire pit with a barbecue. Don't forget the sausages!

plakanek.title: Plakánek Valley
plakanek.description: A sandstone gorge with a stream, ponds and mills. Step out of the garden gate and you'll soon be walking beneath the rocks all the way to Kost Castle.

vesec.title: Vesec u Sobotky
vesec.description: A picturesque historic village with a film-set atmosphere — some twenty log cottages clustered together, as if the nineteenth century had stood still here.

kost.title: Kost Castle
kost.description: One of the best-preserved Gothic castles in Bohemia, set in a valley rather than on a hilltop. A choice of appealing guided tours, including one for children, plus knights' tournaments.

humprecht.title: Humprecht Chateau
humprecht.description: A Baroque hunting lodge above Sobotka. Its oval hall has such remarkable acoustics that people still sing in it today.

trosky.title: Trosky
trosky.description: Two towers, Baba and Panna, perched on the necks of extinct volcanoes. The emblem of Bohemian Paradise — you'll recognise it even from the motorway.

hrubaSkala.title: Hrubá Skála
hrubaSkala.description: A rock town with viewpoints above the treetops and a chateau perched on a sandstone spur.

prachovskeSkaly.title: Prachov Rocks
prachovskeSkaly.description: The most famous rock labyrinth in Bohemian Paradise. Ladders, gorges and viewpoints that look out over half the region.

kingdomCome.title: Kingdom Come
kingdomCome.description: Love Kingdom Come: Deliverance II? Then you're in the right place. Bohemian Paradise is full of spots where history, landscape and the world of the game come beautifully together.

checkInOut.question: When are check-in and check-out?
checkInOut.answer: Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out by 10:00. We're happy to arrange a different time.

howToBook.question: How does booking work?
howToBook.answer: You send us a no-obligation enquiry with your dates and number of guests. Within 24 hours we'll get back to you to confirm availability and the exact price. Only then are the dates firmly booked for you.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel?
cancellation.answer: Yes. The cancellation fee is calculated from the price of the stay, depending on how many days remain until arrival: 61 or more days free of charge, 31–60 days 25%, 15–30 days 50%, 14 days or fewer 100%. We'll refund whatever you've paid above the cancellation fee.

winter.question: Is the cottage suitable in winter too?
winter.answer: Yes. It has electric central heating, so all you need to do is turn up the thermostat, and there's also a wood-burning stove in the living area. The cottage can be reached by car in winter as well.

bikes.question: Where can we keep our bikes?
bikes.answer: Bikes and scooters can be stored and locked up under cover. The car park is twenty metres from the house.

pets.question: Can we bring our dog?
pets.answer: Unfortunately not — pets are not allowed in the cottage. Thank you for understanding.

surroundings.heading: Your Bohemian Paradise starts here
surroundings.perex:
Libošovice is the perfect base for discovering the very best of Bohemian Paradise. Kost Castle, Humprecht Chateau, Trosky, the romantic Plakánek Valley and picturesque Vesec u Sobotky are all close by.
Whether you come for walks and day trips, cycling or nature, or simply want to switch off for a while, Roubený ráj offers a place you'll be glad to come back to every evening.
